headline: Stocks open the holiday week in correction after Friday's tech rout (S&P 500 -3.5%, Nasdaq-100 -5.6%, NVIDIA hit by a reported SEC accounting probe) with Wednesday's PCE the main data risk before Thanksgiving.
rates: Fed funds futures price a December 25bp hike at about 99%, per a Newsquawk week-ahead note, so inflation data matters more than usual.
fed: No Fed speakers are scheduled on the week-ahead calendar; the Beige Book lands Wednesday and recent Waller and Williams comments debated the size of the next hike.
oil: Oil has been drifting lower on supply-surplus worries (Brent in the low-to-mid $90s mid-November) but swings on Iran headlines, including a reported US-Iran ceasefire and talk of renewed strikes.
geo: The Trump-Xi-Putin meeting produced a largely symbolic peace declaration, Iran ceasefire/strike headlines continue, and Trump says trade deals with Mexico and Thailand are progressing.
